svg.title: Content-addressed build cache
svg.desc: Three tenants build nine layers. Each layer is hashed with SHA-256; a layer whose hash already exists only gains a reference, so nine layers become six stored blobs.
svg.text: Identical layers are stored once, across every tenant

g.text: the base image is written once, shared three ways

svg.text: Engine reused from HashVault: SHA-256 content addressing + reference counting. Cold vs warm build times are measured in Phase 7.
